## R Markdown

Get gene groups based upon the t50 values 

pull windows of genes with the same number of genesm centered upon a t50 

return a list of vectors 


load libraries
```{r}

library(GO.db)
library(DescTools)

library(ggrepel)
require(stringr)

library(GOSemSim)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggpubr)
```

Get the genes and summarize features like t50 and avg FC

```{r}

  
#ls("package:org.Mm.eg.db")
# get GO term to gene list
cols <- c("GO", "SYMBOL")
keys <- keys(org.Mm.eg.db)
go_df <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys, cols, keytype="ENTREZID")
go_df$EVIDENCE <- NULL

go_df <- go_df[!duplicated(go_df),]

# check GO genes against max cat 

# how many genes are missing in the symbol data 
table(gene_t50_time$mgi_symbol %in% go_df$SYMBOL, gene_t50_time$max_cat) 
# good enough 

gene_t50_time_GO <- merge(x = go_df, y = gene_t50_time, by.x = "SYMBOL", by.y = "mgi_symbol", all = FALSE)

GO_t50_summary <- gene_t50_time_GO %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(max_cat, GO, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(avg_t50) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(t50_rank=row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(t50_mean = mean(avg_t50),
                   t50_sd = sd(avg_t50),
                   t50_rank_sd = sd(t50_rank),
                   t50_rank_mean = mean(t50_rank),
                  avg_FC_mean = mean(avg_fc), 
                  avg_FC_sd = sd(avg_fc), 
                  gene_num = length(SYMBOL))

GO_t50_all_cat <- gene_t50_time_GO %>% 
  dplyr::group_by( GO, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(all_num = length(SYMBOL))

# calculate enrichment
GO_t50_summary <- merge(x = GO_t50_summary, y = GO_t50_all_cat, by.x = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY"), by.y = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY")) 
GO_t50_summary$gene_freq <-  GO_t50_summary$gene_num / GO_t50_summary$all_num

plot(log10(GO_t50_summary$gene_num),GO_t50_summary$gene_freq)


GO_t50_summary_prune <- GO_t50_summary %>% 
  dplyr::filter(gene_num > 20) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_freq > 0.3) 

plot(GO_t50_summary_prune$t50_sd ,GO_t50_summary_prune$gene_freq)


GO_t50_summary_prune_top <- GO_t50_summary_prune %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(max_cat, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(t50_rank_sd, desc(gene_freq)) %>%
  dplyr::top_n(10)

#GO_t50_summary_prune_top %>%
  
gene_t50_time_GO_prune <- left_join(GO_t50_summary_prune_top[,c("GO", "ONTOLOGY", "max_cat")], gene_t50_time_GO, by = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY", "max_cat"))


```

merge similar GO terms 

```{r}

GO_t50_summary_diff <- GO_t50_summary_prune %>% 
  dplyr::filter(max_cat == "P14_P56") %>%
  dplyr::filter(ONTOLOGY == "MF")

# assocaited GO terms for a single GO term 
hist(GO_sim_mat[match( GO_t50_summary_diff$GO[1], GO_t50_summary_prune_MF$GO),],breaks = 100)

# all GO terms 
GO_sim_mat_diff <- GO_sim_mat[match( GO_t50_summary_diff$GO, GO_t50_summary_prune_MF$GO),match( GO_t50_summary_diff$GO, GO_t50_summary_prune_MF$GO)]

# seems like 0.6 reasonable cutoff 
pheatmap(GO_sim_mat_diff)

```

Order list as above 
Loop 
  find associated terms and group with variable 
  loop to next unassociated term 
  up to 10 

```{r}

GO_t50_summary_diff_ord <-  GO_t50_summary_diff %>%
  dplyr::filter(t50_mean > 12) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(gene_freq)) 
  
GO_t50_summary_diff_ord$GO_cluster <- 0

for (i in 1:nrow(GO_t50_summary_diff_ord)) {
  curr_go <- GO_t50_summary_diff_ord$GO[i]
  assoc_go <- GO_t50_summary_prune_MF$GO[GO_sim_mat[match(curr_go,  GO_t50_summary_prune_MF$GO),] > 0.5 ]
  #print(assoc_go)
  assoc_idx <- which(GO_t50_summary_diff_ord$GO %in% assoc_go)
  #print(assoc_idx)
  for (j in assoc_idx) {
      GO_t50_summary_diff_ord$GO_cluster[j] <-  ifelse (GO_t50_summary_diff_ord$GO_cluster[j] == 0, 
                                                           i, GO_t50_summary_diff_ord$GO_cluster[j])
  
  }
} 



```

```{r, fig.width= 4, fig.height= 8 }
GO_t50_summary_diff_ord_top <- GO_t50_summary_diff_ord %>%
  
  dplyr::arrange(GO_cluster) %>%
  
  dplyr::filter(GO_cluster < 20)


gene_t50_time_GO_diff_ord_top <- left_join(GO_t50_summary_diff_ord_top, gene_t50_time_GO, by = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY", "max_cat"))

gene_t50_time_GO_diff_ord_top$go_desc <-  as.vector(Term(gene_t50_time_GO_diff_ord_top$GO))

gene_t50_time_GO_diff_ord_top <- gene_t50_time_GO_diff_ord_top %>%
  dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL,GO_cluster, .keep_all = TRUE)

jitter <- position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.2)

gene_t50_time_GO_diff_ord_top %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_fc >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(avg_t50 =  as.numeric(Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(avg_fc =  Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(go_desc =  str_wrap(go_desc, width = 25)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(SYMBOL = ifelse(avg_fc >= 4, SYMBOL, "" )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SYMBOL = ifelse(avg_t50 > 10, SYMBOL, "" )) %>%
  ggplot( aes(y = go_desc, x = avg_t50, size = avg_fc, label = SYMBOL)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, position = jitter) + 
  geom_text_repel(force = 10, 
                  size = 5, 
                  position = jitter) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_points, 
                     labels = names(time_points), 
                     name = "Time at 50% max change") +
  
  facet_grid(GO_cluster~., scales = "free_y", shrink = TRUE, space = "free_y") +
  theme_gray() + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(), 
    strip.text = element_blank(), 
    axis.title.x =  element_blank() 
  )


```

# Get child GO terms associated with topGO 

remove very low gene count and low enriched genes 
```{r}
# summarize the GO terms 
go_max <- go_multi_split  %>%
  dplyr::group_by(GO.ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_gene_num = max(Significant), 
            max_enrich = max(enrichment), 
            min_classicFisher = min(classicFisher), 
            min_topgoFisher = min(topgoFisher), 
            min_elimFisher = min(elimFisher))

go_exclude <- go_max %>%
  dplyr::filter(max_gene_num < 6 | max_enrich < 2 | min_elimFisher > 0.01 )



go_multi_split_filt <- go_multi_split[!(go_multi_split$GO.ID %in% go_exclude$GO.ID),]

```


```{r}
go_multi_unique <- unique(go_multi_split_filt$GO.ID)
GO_sim_mat <- outer(X = go_multi_unique, Y = go_multi_unique, FUN =  Vectorize(go_sim))
#pheatmap(GO_sim_mat)
colnames(GO_sim_mat) <- go_multi_unique
row.names(GO_sim_mat) <- go_multi_unique



```


Fetch associated genes, merge with gene specific timecourse data and summarize 
```{r}
source('~/Dropbox/jp_seq/go2sym.R')
GO_genes <- go2sym(go_multi_split_filt$GO.ID, ontology = "MF", return_df = TRUE)

```


Get summary information about when the genes turn on (t50), this only makes sense if it is for the whole max_cat   

```{r}
gene_t50_time_GO_2fc <- merge(x = GO_genes, y = gene_t50_time_2fc, by.x = "SYMBOL", by.y = "mgi_symbol", all = FALSE)

GO_t50_summary_2fc <- gene_t50_time_GO_2fc %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_fc >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(max_cat, GO, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(avg_t50) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(t50_rank=row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(t50_mean = mean(avg_t50),
                   t50_sd = sd(avg_t50),
                   t50_rank_sd = sd(t50_rank),
                   t50_rank_mean = mean(t50_rank),
                  avg_FC_mean = mean(avg_fc), 
                  avg_FC_sd = sd(avg_fc), 
                  gene_num = length(SYMBOL))

GO_t50_all_cat_2fc <- gene_t50_time_GO_2fc %>% 
  dplyr::group_by( GO, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(all_num = length(SYMBOL))

# calculate enrichment
GO_t50_summary_2fc <- merge(x = GO_t50_summary_2fc, y = GO_t50_all_cat_2fc, by.x = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY"), by.y = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY")) 
GO_t50_summary_2fc$gene_freq <-  GO_t50_summary_2fc$gene_num / GO_t50_summary_2fc$all_num

```

```{r}
 dplyr::arrange( desc(Significant), elimFisher)

go_multi_split_sum_diff <- go_cluster(go_multi_split_sum_diff,  GO_sim_mat, GO_name = "GO.ID", cutoff = 0.6)
```

To get a variety of terms pick a single go term based on GO_cluster 

```{r, eval = TRUE}
go_multi_split_sum_diff_top <- go_multi_split_sum_diff %>%
  dplyr::filter(max_cat == "P14_P56") %>%
#  dplyr::filter(t50_sd  < 10) %>%
#  dplyr::filter(t50_rank_mean  < 20) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(time_window, GO_cluster) %>%
  slice(which.max(Significant)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  droplevels() 


go_multi_split_sum_diff_top <- go_multi_split_sum_diff_top %>%
  dplyr::group_by(time_window) %>%
  dplyr::arrange( desc(Significant), elimFisher) %>%
  dplyr::slice(c(1,2))

go_multi_split_sum_diff_top <- go_multi_split_sum_diff_top %>%
  dplyr::select(-max_cat )

go_multi_split_sum_diff_top$Term <- factor(go_multi_split_sum_diff_top$Term, 
                                      levels = unique(go_multi_split_sum_diff_top$Term[order(go_multi_split_sum_diff_top$t50_mean)]))


gene_t50_time_GO_2fc_sum_gene<- left_join(go_multi_split_sum_diff_top, gene_t50_time_GO_2fc, by = c("GO.ID" = "GO", "ONTOLOGY" = "ONTOLOGY"))
```  
